title: Concept: Refresh header uses a protocol-relative target
description: A Refresh header points at a protocol-relative URL. The browser resolves it against the response scheme and navigates to another host, so a value that looks local in a header dump becomes a cross-origin redirect at parse time; if any part of the value is attacker-influenced it is an open redirect.
applicability: Responses that emit a Refresh header with a URL target.
risk: Cross-origin navigation to a destination the server did not pin; MEDIUM severity when the value is influenced by request input.
